meta.title: Meat food truck in Samaria – Brukhin | Ramta רמתא
meta.description: Ramta is a kosher (mehadrin) meat food truck in Brukhin, Samaria. Burgers, beer-braised pulled beef and meat platters facing the hills, plus intimate sunset events. Hours, menu and Waze directions.
meta.ogAlt: Ramta's terrace at sunset, facing the hills of Samaria

hero.title: Food, view, land
hero.lead: Fresh meat off the griddle, wooden tables and the sun setting over the Samarian hills. We're waiting for you in Brukhin.
hero.videoLabel: Ramta's terrace at sunset, with lavender planters and string lights

blocks.title: The best sunset in Samaria, with a hot plate
blocks.text: Our terrace faces west, towards the hills. In the evening the string lights come on, sometimes there's a guitar, and there's always a table with a view.
blocks.videoLabel: An evening on the terrace: string lights and a guitarist

blocks.title: Fresh meat, patient cooking, served hot
blocks.text: The brisket cooks for hours, the pulled beef rests in beer, and the patties only hit the griddle once you order.
blocks.videoLabel: Sauce poured over a pulled beef sandwich

blocks.text: Set tables, Ramta's food and the sunset as your backdrop. A birthday, a team evening or a family meal – we take care of everything.

info.title: Brukhin, Samaria
info.addressNote: An open-air spot facing west, towards the hills of Samaria.
info.mapNote: The map only loads when you click (Google Maps).
info.hoursNote: Winter hours may change. Updates in the banner at the top and on Instagram.
info.parking: Free parking next to the site.

items.a: Yes, Ramta is kosher mehadrin. You can ask to see the certificate on site.
Absolutely. There are picnic tables outside and dishes kids love, like burgers and fries.
Yes, free parking right next to the site.

items.q: Can we hold an event with you?
items.a: Yes. We host small events with the view: birthdays, company and family events. Send the details through the events form and Yuval will get back to you.
Yes, through the pickup order on the site or on WhatsApp. Choose a pickup time within opening hours and we'll confirm.
Tell us about any allergy when you order. We'll tell you exactly what's in each dish.
Usually Tuesday and Wednesday 12:00–22:00 and Thursday 12:00–23:00. Winter hours can change, so check the banner at the top.

footer.tagline: Meat food truck and boutique events in Brukhin, Samaria.
footer.legalText: This site collects no data and uses no tracking cookies. The order and event forms open WhatsApp on your device; nothing is stored on the site.
